request.task: T3A closure for exact Fable F-01 route normalization and bound receipt production
request.head: 899b39433c4be242b4b3adcd39f3e6cd53df99c0

audit.proof_assessment: Static review of the allowlisted route slice only; no execution proof was supplied. After RunIdSchema acceptance, alphanumeric-leading IDs are copied byte-for-byte into job.projectId; other accepted IDs (dash/underscore-leading under an ASCII 4–40 run-id grammar) are prefixed with the 43-char constant and lowercase 2-digit hex of every code unit. That image is length 51–123, so it cannot equal any 4–40 external run ID and stays inside a 1–128 ID bound. Hex of the full original id is injective and reversible for ASCII. Response runId is still parsedRunId.data. Auth, read+propose-only assignment, and empty grants are unchanged. New tests cover short and 40-char dash/underscore IDs at HTTP 200 with original runId and receipt.status complete, and the frozen Date.now pair -abc1 vs run--abc1 via distinct jobSha256 (this pair fails the old run- prefix alias).
residual_risks: Executor/projectId schema and timestamp source are outside the slice; HTTP 200 is the only evidence the mapped id is accepted.
vi.spyOn(Date, now) does not freeze new Date(); if jobSha256 mixed in wall-clock fields the specified pair would be a weaker collision oracle.
jobId still omits run/project identity; distinctness is only claimed on receipt.jobSha256.
